title: Harper Vance CLI
description: Bring performance reports and live target updates into your own workflow.
availability: Available with Desk Intelligence and Firm Wide Enterprise. Custom agreements require an explicit CLI grant. Account permissions and history limits apply.
restrictedBody: Your organization can continue using its licensed dashboard features. Contact us to discuss higher-tier CLI access.
secureBody: Sign in with your own account and authenticator. Never share passwords, authenticator codes, token files or administrator credentials.

publicDocs.description: Performance reports and live target updates, ready for your workflow. Explore the data available through the Harper Vance CLI.
publicDocs.accessBody: CLI access is included with Desk Intelligence and Firm Wide Enterprise. Custom agreements require an explicit CLI grant.

publicDocs.guideBody: Sign in to access installation instructions, the full command reference, downloads and Postman collections.
